change: Moved Gluteus Medius from primary to secondary. In hip thrusts, Gluteus Maximus is the prime mover for hip extension; Gluteus Medius acts as a hip stabilizer and abductor (secondary), not a primary mover. EMG research confirms Gluteus Maximus dominates activation. All other entries retained.

Added Gluteus Maximus (glutes) and Hamstrings (Biceps Femoris, Semitendinosus) as co-primary muscles alongside Erector Spinae. In Bow Pose (Dhanurasana), the gluteus maximus actively extends the hips and the hamstrings flex the knees to lift the thighs — both are prime movers in achieving and sustaining the pose. Previously only Lower Back was listed as primary, which was incomplete. Posterior Deltoid retained as secondary (assists in shoulder retraction to grip ankles).

Removed Rhomboids from primary. Shrugs are primarily a scapular elevation exercise targeting Upper Traps; Rhomboids perform scapular retraction and are secondary/assisting muscles, not prime movers in a shrug. Moved Rhomboids to secondary alongside Rotator Cuff and Wrist Flexors.

Removed Tibialis (Shin group) from secondary. The tibialis anterior performs dorsiflexion (pulling toes up), which is the opposite of the plantarflexion movement in a calf raise. It is not activated during calf raises. Soleus retained as secondary under Calves bucket. Primary Gastrocnemius Lateral + Medial unchanged.

No changes. Obliques (External + Internal) as primary confirmed by EMG research on anti-rotation exercises. Secondary abs, Lower Back (Erector Spinae), and Anterior Deltoids (arm extension component) all verified as appropriate. Category Resistance, equipment cable, trackingMode timed all correct.
